pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions; zero pyramiding permitted unless the base position has locked in positive trailing profit exceeding $10.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory structural volume and order book delta confirmation; no entries allowed during 15-minute high-impact economic news windows or when ATR exceeds 3x the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation once unrealized profit hits $15, scaling out 50% of the volume at $20 and letting the remainder run to $30+.
